patterns.name: Global nav
patterns.description: 44px frosted bar (rgba(255,255,255,.8), saturate(180%) blur(20px)), content max 1024px with 22px padding: logo, eleven 12px links, search and bag icons. Hovering a link opens one shared flyout panel under the bar; its height animates 0 to auto (516 to 552px measured) and its background turns #fafafc, while a curtain rgba(232,232,237,.4) with blur(20px) dims the page.

patterns.name: Flyout content
patterns.description: Padding 40px top. Groups max 25% wide with 44px end padding; the first group is elevated (50%, 88px end padding) with 24px/600 links. Group headers 12px #6e6e73, links 12px/600 #333336. Items fade down 4px over 0.32s, each 20ms after the last, from an 80ms delay; closing waits 0.12s.

patterns.name: Mobile menu
patterns.description: At 833px and below the bar is 48px with search, bag and a two-line menu button. The menu fills the screen: 28px/600 links fade down 8px over 0.24s from a 0.2s delay, 20ms apart. A category slides the next level in 8px from the right with a Back chevron (0.24s, 0.16s delay, scale .8 to 1).

patterns.name: Region banner
patterns.description: 70px #fafafc bar above the nav (135px stacked on phones): 12px copy, a 42px select (radius 11, 3px border rgba(0,0,0,.04)), a #1d1d1f Continue button (radius 8) and a close button.

patterns.name: Local nav
patterns.description: 52px sticky bar under the global nav (48 on phones): 21px/600 title, 12px chapter links and a 24px blue Buy pill. Transparent over the hero, frosted once scrolled 114px.

patterns.name: Promo tile column
patterns.description: Full-bleed tiles 692px tall stacked 12px apart, then a 2-column grid of 702x580 tiles. Copy is centred at the top: headline, subhead, two pill buttons; media fills the rest.

patterns.name: Chapter column
patterns.description: Story pages use an 87.5% / 1260px column with 144 or 160px vertical padding, eyebrow + 48px headline intros and full-bleed media; tone alternates white, #f5f5f7, #000000 and #1d1d1f.

patterns.name: Card shelf
patterns.description: Horizontal scrolling row of 372px (or 400/696px) cards with radius 28 starting at the column edge and bleeding off the right; 36px round paddles under the row at the right.

patterns.name: Footer
patterns.description: #f5f5f7, 12px/1.33337 rgba(0,0,0,.56). Footnotes (17px top, 11px bottom, 1px rule), breadcrumb, five 196px directory columns with 600 headings and 9.6px link gaps, a shop line with a #0066cc link, then copyright and five legal links split by 1px rules. On phones each section becomes a 37px accordion row.

layout.responsive: Three tiers: large above 1068px, medium to 734px, small below. The global nav collapses at 833px. Tiles keep their order and shrink (692 to 500px), grids drop to one column, shelves keep scrolling horizontally with 300px cards, type steps down (56 to 32px, 48 to 32px) and the footer directory turns into an accordion.

keyframes.name: globalnav-chevron-hover-off

keyframes.name: globalnav-flyout-slide-forward-previous
keyframes.use: Mobile menu: current level leaves to the left (8px) when a category opens

keyframes.name: globalnav-flyout-slide-back-previous

keyframes.name: globalnav-flyout-slide-back-next
keyframes.use: Mobile menu: parent level returns from the left when Back is pressed

keyframes.name: globalnav-scrim-height-change
keyframes.use: Global nav: flyout panel height morphs between two open menus

keyframes.name: globalnav-fade-in

unmeasured: Scroll-driven script animations on product detail and story pages (pinned hero media scrubbing frames, headline reveals tied to scroll position, sticky device frames): not measured.
Video playback in hero tiles and galleries, including autoplay and the timing of the dot navigation, is script-driven: not measured.
WebGL scenes on product pages (three.js) for 3D product views: not measured.
Store loading states beyond the shimmer and the progress spinner: not measured (store paths behind certificate errors were not forced).
Values hero sticky media: the frame stays pinned for a 1480px track while the headline changes; the script-driven crossfade is not measured.

principles: The product is the hero: full-bleed media fills each tile or chapter and copy stays short, centred and above it.
One accent: #0071e3 for actions, #0066cc for links; everything else is grey scale from #1d1d1f to #f5f5f7, black and charcoal for drama.
Every button is a 980px pill; regular 17px, small 14px; two at most side by side.
Type is SF Pro with tight display tracking: 56/48/40px 600 headlines, 17px body with -0.022em, 12px chrome.
Chrome is frosted: the global nav, local nav and flyout curtain blur what is under them instead of using solid bars.
Spacing is generous and fixed per tier: 144-160px between chapters, 12px between tiles, 1260px or 980px columns.
Motion is short and quiet: 0.24-0.32s with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1), small 4-8px offsets and 20ms staggers.
Legal and footnote text is part of the design: numbered footnotes, a full directory and a legal row close every page.
avoid: Shadows on most surfaces; only store and news cards carry a soft 12px shadow.
Square or slightly rounded buttons; buttons are always pills.
Multiple accent colors in one view; tints like the store title or service red stay on one page family.
Dense paragraphs in tiles; tiles carry a headline, one line and buttons.
Opaque sticky bars; the nav must stay translucent with blur.
